stories.title: Lebanese child succumbs to his wounds after Israeli cluster bomb blast
stories.summary: Lebanese child succumbs to his wounds after Israeli cluster bomb blast A Lebanese child was killed on Monday when a cluster bomb left behind by Israeli attacks in southern Lebanon exploded, Lebanon’s official National News Agency reported. Mohammad Ali Ibrahim succumbed to his wounds in the al-Arid neighbourhood of Haboush. Another boy was also injured in the blast, but no further details were provided.

A homicide investigation is underway, with the alleged offenders still at large. Acting supt Gretchin Atkins said the man, who was yet to be formally identified, was at his Glen Alpine home with his family in the early hours of Tuesday morning when multiple individuals allegedly broke in. stories.title: (LEAD) Presidential policy chief Kim resigns
stories.summary: Presidential chief of staff for policy. Kim Yong-beom has offered to resign, and President Lee Jae Myung has accepted his resignation, a presidential spokesperson said Tuesday. Kim tendered his resignation the previous day, and Lee accepted it earlier Tuesday, spokesperson Kang Yu-jung said at a press briefing. The presidential spokesperson did not provide a reason for Kim's resignation, but it comes amid persistent criticism that single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) launched in May under his leadership may be amplifying stock market volatility. Kim has been serving as presidential policy chief since the launch of the Lee administration in June last year.
